description: Designed, built and shipped 3 complete applications (web and mobile) to production, from idea to launch, entirely on my own
Published Joblyx on Google Play, an AI career assistant (Flutter + FastAPI) with a career roadmap, resume coach and interview simulator powered by OpenAI, answers rendered as they stream (SSE)
Built a RAG pipeline (ChromaDB, local embeddings, LangChain) and 4 analysis agents combining linters and an LLM to audit GitHub repositories automatically (CommitClarify)
Developed OubliePas, a bilingual subscription-tracking PWA (React 19 + FastAPI) with email reminders and web push notifications, covered by 1,396 automated tests
Secured authentication with JWT token rotation, OAuth (LinkedIn, GitHub, Google) and role management, with Sentry monitoring in production
Automated database migrations at startup (Alembic) and deployed on Railway/Vercel with Docker, PostgreSQL and Redis
Built end-to-end full stack features (FastAPI/Flask + React), shipped to production
Integrated AWS S3 cloud storage (boto3) for secure handling of user files
Automated tests and deployments through a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline, removing manual deployments
Set up unit tests to reduce regressions in production
Took part in code reviews (pull requests) within an agile team, contributing to more reliable releases
Automated internal processes with Python scripts, cutting manual work and human error
Diagnosed and resolved technical incidents in a production environment
Handled support and maintenance of the company's IT equipment
Developed Python scripts automating repetitive tasks, making internal processes more reliable
Analysed and visualised data with Pandas/Numpy to support decision-making
Contributed to the maintenance and evolution of internal software tools
